dogecoin.text: Bitwise filed with the SEC to list an exchange-traded fund (ETF) tracking the price of the popular memecoin Dogecoin (DOGE). DOGE has amassed a $47 billion market cap since launching in 2015 and is the eighth largest cryptocurrency overall. https://t.co/bqCOsH6i57

The memecoin market is consolidating into the major memecoins, according to Zeta Markets co-founder Anmol Singh. Dogecoin leads the market with 53% of the market cap, followed by SHIB and PEPE with $7.7 billion and $2.9 billion respectively. https://t.co/tdnaly2MBo
